overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not reasonably anticipate discussing the Lake Street septic matter 48 hours before the meeting, so it need not appear on the notice.

allegations.summary: A resident alleged the Board failed to list a septic-system discussion (Lake Street property) on its May 17 meeting notice, which had only a catch-all unanticipated-items line.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board chair did not anticipate discussing this matter during the May 17 meeting, and that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.
